## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 3f63e389830868dead1b3d68db9f4016216cc06d

- **Shape:** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36172` CLEAN at 3f63e38983: open, draft, base main; first line `Fixes #36146`; no closing keyword on any other card; three files under `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` (+212/−32), which publish nothing, hence `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Tier:** not governed. `check-governed-merges.mjs` pins `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` (the relay's workflow and App key) as H, not `scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`. None of the three files is an always-H guard instrument.
- **The id comes only from `GET /repos/{repo}`:**
  - `advisoryListRepoIdOf` takes `id` only from a 200 answer whose `full_name` equals the stroke's repo (case-folded), and only when it is a positive safe integer; a string `"4242"` is refused.
  - `advisoryListNextCursor` checks origin, exactly one `state` (the walked one) and exactly one `after` in `ADVISORY_LIST_CURSOR_SHAPE` before it considers the path. A numeric path (`^/repositories/[1-9][0-9]{0,19}/security-advisories$`) then answers `needsRepoId` until the own id is read, and follows only when `String(repoId) === numeric[1]`. The link's id is only ever compared, never used.
  - The next request is built by `advisoryListPagePath(repo, state, after)` on the relay's `/repos/` path. The link URL is never requested.
  - The own-repo read happens at most once per listing (pinned: 1 read for the real walk, 0 for a `/repos/`-spelled walk).
- **Disclosure, the diagnostic:** `advisoryListLinkShape` prints:
  - the next-link count;
  - same or other origin;
  - path segments, with only `repos` / `repositories` / `security-advisories` literal and `OWNER/NAME`, `ID`, `N` or `SEG` in place of every other segment, plus a same/other/case-folded note;
  - query parameter names, only when they match `^[a-z_]{1,32}$` (else `NAME`);
  - for `state` and `after`, only how they stand.

  No cursor, id, owner, name, host, state value or advisory field is printed. The repo-id-unread text carries the status alone. The validate battery's leak test sweeps every refused link plus a marker-bearing cursor and parameter name, with an empty leak list. The execute MARKER sweep covers 46 runs with no leak and a positive control.
- **Self-tests run on this head:** `ops.mjs --self-test` EXIT 0; `validate.mjs --self-test` 436/436 EXIT 0; `execute.mjs --self-test` 433/433 EXIT 0.
- **Ablation:** I replaced the id equality (`String(repoId) === numeric[1] ? … : refuse`) with an unconditional follow, then restored it. validate went 2/436 ✗ (the other-id refusal and the real-shape `4243` case) and execute 2/433 ✗ (the off-link sweep and "a numeric link naming ANY other id"). So the new cases see the guard.
- **Gates:** 26 success, 21 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending at 3f63e38983. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both success.
- **Premise and stop condition, NOT MEASURED here:**
  - The card asked that the real advisory `Link` header be measured first. This project's seat account cannot read advisories, so the dev pinned the shape from GitHub's pagination guide and a cursor-paged issues `Link` measured on this repository. I did not re-measure it; I have no header read.
  - The diff still answers the card's own fallback: on any refusal, the shape-only diagnostic now prints what the real link broke. A `page=`-only link (card candidate 2) and an off-alphabet cursor (candidate 3) stay refused.
  - The card's re-check (`dispatch.mjs … advisory_list --reveal` from a security seat) is the real proof and is owed after merge. If it still fails, its job log now names the shape and #36146 reopens on that reading.
- **Accepted:** the dev's open question (a `/repos/` link in another letter case) is answered A, keep refusing, as the area chose. The shape names the case-folded variant, so it is diagnosable.
- **Landing:** not governed, under 3,000 lines, `Clause-②: no`, no contract record owed. The area lands it (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36172` first) and tells the security seat that the re-check is due.
